title: BLS powers-of-tau k29: counted-X 925 kernel under runtime cap (F=999/1000)

claims.statement: For the protected BLS12-381 powers-of-tau target, the complete paired class-walk algorithm and argument supplied here has W(2^20)<=2^116.242064500694263 reference units at C=2000 and success>=0.39 conditional on explicitly disclosed H1-H5 in source-proof.md plus H-new of proof.md section 24 with H4 restated as the per-class pair-fraction floor F=999/1000 of proof.md section 16. It uses only A_1 and A_(2^20), and the same W(n) bound holds for 2^20<=n<r. Preprocessing, failure/cap work, communication, verification, recovery included. Total memory<2^122.0004 bytes, preprocessing<2^115.2594 units and included, no advice. Analytical conditional bound, not a production execution. Section 1: 925 mean-charge kernel (K1/K2/K3), Callgrind mean 924.174, 24 paths, 509-lane audit with exact X-counter, 40/invocation row (section 20); section 2: coverage target 0.49511789492 (least 10^-12 multiple, floor >= 0.39+10^-10); sections 11-12: caps at 1.00001/1.000031 x mean, exponents asserted; sections 9-12: record path (GEN12/RELAY14, INS12, LOOK6+capped EXT3, CMP8/cap-2, four setup rows, chain schedule, 2^58 heads); section 17: permuted key (head one lsr; combine deleted); section 18: pool-cap check once per owner per wave; section 19: full-address chain links (CMP8); section 21: EXT-cap check once per owner per link-buffer per wave (EXT3 since section 23); section 22: pool pointer replaces the owner counter (INS12, executed by a64.py); section 23: k64 load deferred behind the nonempty test (LOOK6 + EXT3, executed by a64.py); section 24: counted X-tier repricing at mean 925 under runtime cap XCAP (H-new disclosed); section 16: per-class floor F = 999/1000 on extended measurements, checked per class; section 15: exact restart price SMX 630722 from one generated listing on the shipped kernel bodies, executed end to end, superseding section 13.

experiments.purpose: Recompute amended ledger + exact log ceiling; rerun the planner (greedy + s16 augmentation; per-class pair fractions, capped and uncapped), transport/toy evidence, parity-key checks, the kernel audit (path enumeration, 509 lanes, stride-128 footprint, exact X-counter), the K1 carry-bound witness and the record-path audits (s17 packed layout, s18-23 asserts, executed INS12/LOOK6). Finite evidence only.
